reason: KBRA is a 650-720 person global NRSRO ($136M revenue, Parthenon Capital-backed, offices in 7 countries) with a sitting full-time Chief Technology Officer (Bill Wright) and Engineering at 44.5% of headcount - far too large and too well-staffed technically for a fractional CTO, and the direct inverse of Shawn's bus-factor-1 SMB niche; all four matched jobs are credit-research analyst roles (Funds Ratings Associate, Corporate Portfolio Finance Research), not evidence of an unowned legacy platform, and the only tech-adjacent fresh postings (Business Applications Engineering Manager, Data Steward - Data Operations, Revenue Operations Data & Systems) are routine internal hires inside an existing engineering org rather than a confession of missing technical leadership.
